integrity: The 41 labeled tetrahedra agree with the facet list in Benedetti--Lutz Theorem 6.3, and their face vector is (14,66,94,41). Exact finite deletion/link recursion is provided as a reproducible certificate of the stated two-step counts.
scientific_limitations: Exact first- and second-query classification for the published 14-vertex Rudin triangulation, not a general theorem for all non-evasive balls or a classification of full query decision trees.
title: Every vertex of Rudin's ball is a non-evasive first move
